```{r}
# This is a spare code chunk for the first paper, showing how to create a map of SAMHE schools and their paired AURN sites, with lines connecting them and colored by distance.

pacman::p_load(dplyr, sf, ggplot2, rnaturalearth, viridis)

# ---- 1. Prepare pairing table ----
pairs <- In_Out_24 %>%
  distinct(SchoolId_short, site, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(
    SchoolId_short,
    SAMHE_lon = SchoolLongitude,
    SAMHE_lat = SchoolLatitude,
    AURN_site = site,
    AURN_lon  = longitude,
    AURN_lat  = latitude,
    distance_km = km_distance_to_AURN
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SAMHE_lat), !is.na(AURN_lat))

# ---- 2. Descriptive statistics label ----
dist_stats <- pairs %>%
  summarise(
    n_schools = n_distinct(SchoolId_short),
    mean_km   = mean(distance_km, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_km = median(distance_km, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_km    = min(distance_km, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_km    = max(distance_km, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

stats_label <- paste0(
  "n = ", dist_stats$n_schools, "\n",
  "Mean = ", round(dist_stats$mean_km, 1), " km\n",
  "Median = ", round(dist_stats$median_km, 1), " km\n",
  "Range = ", round(dist_stats$min_km, 1), "–", round(dist_stats$max_km, 0), " km"
)

# ---- 3. Convert to sf objects ----
samhe_sf <- st_as_sf(pairs,
                     coords = c("SAMHE_lon","SAMHE_lat"),
                     crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

aurn_sf  <- st_as_sf(pairs,
                     coords = c("AURN_lon","AURN_lat"),
                     crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

lines_sf <- st_as_sf(
  pairs %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(geometry = st_sfc(
      st_linestring(matrix(c(SAMHE_lon, SAMHE_lat,
                             AURN_lon,  AURN_lat),
                           ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)),
      crs = 4326)) %>%
    ungroup(),
  crs = 4326
)

# ---- 4. UK basemap ----
uk <- rnaturalearth::ne_states(country = "United Kingdom",
                               returnclass = "sf")

# ---- 5. Plot ----
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = uk,
          fill = "white",
          colour = "grey40",
          linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = lines_sf,
          aes(color = distance_km),
          linewidth = 0.25,
          alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_sf(data = aurn_sf,
          aes(fill = distance_km),
          shape = 21,
          colour = "black",
          size = 2.2,
          stroke = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = samhe_sf,
          aes(shape = "SAMHE site"),
          colour = "red",
          size = 1.2) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-8.5, 2.5),
           ylim = c(49.5, 60.9),
           clip = "off") +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Site type",
                     values = c("SAMHE site" = 16)) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Distance to AURN (km)") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Distance to AURN (km)") +
  guides(
    shape = guide_legend(order = 1),
    color = guide_colorbar(order = 2),
    fill  = guide_colorbar(order = 2)
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 80, 5.5, 5.5)
  ) +
  annotate("text",
           x = 2.7,
           y = 52.5,
           label = stats_label,
           hjust = 0,
           vjust = 1,
           size = 3.5)
```

```{r}
daily <- In_Out_24 %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(DateTime)) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    Indoor_mean   = mean(pm02, na.rm = TRUE),
    Indoor_q25    = quantile(pm02, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Indoor_q75    = quantile(pm02, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    Outdoor_mean  = mean(pm2.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    Outdoor_q25   = quantile(pm2.5, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Outdoor_q75   = quantile(pm2.5, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -date,
    names_to = c("site", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(Indoor|Outdoor)_(mean|q25|q75)"
  )

wide_daily <- daily %>%
  select(date, site, mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = site, values_from = mean) %>%
  drop_na(Indoor, Outdoor)

r <- cor(wide_daily$Indoor, wide_daily$Outdoor, method = "pearson")
r2 <- r^2
p <- cor.test(wide_daily$Indoor, wide_daily$Outdoor, method = "pearson")$p.value

modStats(
  wide_daily,
  mod = "Indoor",
  obs = "Outdoor"
)

ggplot(daily, aes(x = date, y = mean, colour = site, fill = site)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75), alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.25) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(Outdoor = "#E57200", Indoor = "#7A1FA2"),
    labels = c(Outdoor = "Outdoor (DEFRA)", Indoor = "Indoor (SAMHE)")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(Outdoor = "#E57200", Indoor = "#7A1FA2"),
    labels = c(Outdoor = "Outdoor (DEFRA)", Indoor = "Indoor (SAMHE)")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = expression("Daily mean PM"[2.5]),
    colour = NULL, fill = NULL
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = min(daily$date) +30,
    y = max(daily$mean),
    label = paste0("R² = ", round(r2, 2), ", p < 0.001"),
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1,
    size = 5
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top"
    #aspect.ratio = 0.25
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_breaks = "3 months",
    date_labels = "%b '%y",
    expand = c(0, 0)
  )
  ggsave("plot.png", width = 24, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}


# This is a spare code chunk for the first paper, showing how to create a scatter plot of annual mean indoor vs outdoor PM2.5 across schools, with a regression line and correlation statistics.
# ---- 1. Prepare annual means ----
df_annual <- In_Out_24 %>%
  mutate(Year = as.integer(format(DateTime, "%Y"))) %>%
  filter(Year %in% 2023:2025) %>% 
  group_by(SchoolId_short) %>%
  summarise(
    indoor_pm25  = mean(pm02, na.rm = TRUE), #
    outdoor_pm25 = mean(pm2.5, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop" 
  ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(indoor_pm25), !is.na(outdoor_pm25)) 

# ---- 2. Correlation + regression ----
cor_val <- cor(df_annual$outdoor_pm25,
               df_annual$indoor_pm25,
               method = "pearson",
               use = "complete.obs")

lm_fit <- lm(indoor_pm25 ~ outdoor_pm25, data = df_annual)

stats_label <- paste0(
  "n = ", nrow(df_annual), "\n",
  "r = ", round(cor_val, 2), "\n",
  "R² = ", round(summary(lm_fit)$r.squared, 2), "\n",
  "Indoor = ",
  round(coef(lm_fit)[1], 2), " + ",
  round(coef(lm_fit)[2], 2), " × Outdoor"
)

# ---- 3. Plot ----
scatterPlot(
  df_annual,
  x = "outdoor_pm25",
  y = "indoor_pm25",
  linear = TRUE,
  cor = TRUE,
  cex = 0.5,
  xlim = c(0, 15),
  ylim = c(0, 15),
  main = "Indoor vs Outdoor PM2.5 (2023:2025 annual means)"
)
```
